items.text: Mike LaFleur said Jeremiyah Love (ARI) tweaked his other ankle Sunday @NYG, where Love ran 14 times for 63. Love said afterward the coaches are managing his workload and that he told them to play Tyler Allgeier and Bam Knight. He is RB14 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's practice report before DET.

Tyler Allgeier (ARI) ran 8 times for 42 and a TD @NYG, and he took 3 of the 5 goal-line snaps in Week 3. With Jeremiyah Love's ankle and a managed workload, Allgeier is the back who gains, and the usage already shows it. RB44 rest of season for me. Claim him, 3 to 6 percent of FAAB.

Seattle is signing Joe Mixon after a Monday workout, with Jadarian Price on IR and Zach Charbonnet's practice window off PUP open. Emanuel Wilson (SEA) had 21 carries, 4 targets and 2 TDs vs LAC, so the backfield is his for now, but the lead is a week or two. Claim him, 8 to 12 percent of FAAB.

items.watch: his first active game and his snap share
items.text: Joe Mixon (SEA) is signing in Seattle after a workout, joining Emanuel Wilson, George Holani and Zach Charbonnet, who is back at practice off PUP. Mixon has not played this season, so he is a depth back until he gets on the field. Monitor his first active game and his snap share.

Keaton Mitchell (LAC) touched the ball 15 times @SEA to Omarion Hampton's 9, a week after 8 carries for 52 on 38 percent of the snaps. Hampton scored, and the split is close to even now. Hampton is RB12 rest of season for me; hold him. Mitchell is RB46 rest of season. Claim him, 4 to 8 percent of FAAB.

Rashawn Slater (LAC) is believed to have a high-ankle sprain from the 30-23 loss @SEA and will miss time, and Joe Alt left the same game with a neck injury. That is both starting tackles for a team on four straight losses. Justin Herbert is QB13 rest of season for me. Monitor Joe Alt's practice status Wednesday.

Romeo Doubs (NE) caught 2 TDs in the 29-26 win @BUF with A.J. Brown on IR until Week 6 at the earliest and Mack Hollins out after the third quarter with the calf. The outside targets are his until Brown is back, which makes him a short-term flex. WR50 rest of season for me. Add him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.

items.why: He is on IR and should sit in an IR spot; if your league has none and you need the bench spot, or he is not practicing by Week 7, drop him.
items.text: Jordyn Tyson (NO) is unlikely to play before Week 7 with the hamstring, per team sources, and Kellen Moore did not expect him to practice this week. WR58 rest of season for me. Hold him in an IR spot; drop him only if you have none or he is not practicing by Week 7.

Pat Bryant (DEN) was carted off with a leg injury in the 24-14 loss @SF, after 40 snaps (67 percent) the week before. RJ Harvey caught 10 for 68 in the same game and takes more of the short work if Bryant misses time. Bryant is WR63 rest of season for me. Monitor the diagnosis this week.

Noah Fant (NO) is inactive vs ATL tonight with the abdominal injury that limited him in practice all week. Juwan Johnson (NO) caught 8 for 48 and two scores vs LV and has the tight end snaps to himself, and he is TE8 for me tonight.

Tank Bigsby (PHI) needs surgery for a core muscle injury he aggravated late Sunday vs LAR and is headed to injured reserve for about six weeks. That ends the claim case from Sunday night. He is RB55 rest of season for me. Drop Bigsby for any add on the list.

With Tank Bigsby (PHI) on the way to IR, Will Shipley (PHI) is the only other back on Philadelphia's active roster behind Saquon Barkley. Shipley ran 6 times for 23 Sunday after Barkley left. He is RB92 rest of season for me, a one-week fill-in if Barkley sits in London. Claim him, 3 to 6 percent of FAAB, and only if you roster Barkley or need a Week 5 body.

Saquon Barkley (PHI) had tests on the right hamstring Monday, and Nick Sirianni said the Eagles will have more answers probably Wednesday before the London game vs JAX. The injury is not believed to be overly serious, per NFL Network. Barkley is RB8 rest of season for me; hold him. Monitor; Sirianni's update Wednesday.

Jesse Minter had no diagnosis on Lamar Jackson's (BAL) left ankle Monday after the MRI, said the Ravens are still gathering information, and said he does not expect it to be crazy long-term. Minter would not commit to Sunday night vs ATL. Jackson is QB2 rest of season for me; hold him. In superflex, Tyler Huntley stays a stash. Monitor Jackson; Wednesday's practice report.

items.watch: the concussion protocol and Wednesday's practice report
items.text: Zac Taylor said Monday the Bengals will take Ja'Marr Chase (CIN) and Tee Higgins (CIN) day to day. Chase is still in the concussion protocol; Higgins has an adductor strain from the final drive after 11 catches for 157. Higgins is WR16 rest of season for me; hold him. Chase is WR1 rest of season. Monitor Chase; the concussion protocol and Wednesday's practice report before CIN hosts MIA.

items.why: Kansas City is on bye in Week 5; a missed practice in the week of the LAC game on Oct 18 would change the call.
items.text: Rashee Rice (KC) hurt the hamstring in the first quarter @LV. Andy Reid called it a tweak, NFL Network called it relatively minor Monday, and a Sunday report said he could miss several weeks. Kansas City is off in Week 5, so the next game is Oct 18 vs LAC. Tyquan Thornton (KC) is out indefinitely with the dislocated ankle; drop Thornton for any add. Rice is WR17 rest of season for me. Hold Rice.

Imaging on Kyle Monangai's (CHI) right thumb showed nothing concerning, and Ben Johnson called it day to day Monday and expects him to be fine for GB. Monangai ran 30 times for 146 and two touchdowns vs NYJ after D'Andre Swift (CHI) lost a fumble and sat the rest of the game. Monangai is RB36 rest of season for me and Swift RB13; hold Swift until the Week 5 split shows who leads. Monitor Monangai; Wednesday's practice report.

items.why: A practice return before Week 6 would put him back in the QB1 range; a setback on the hamstring would make him a drop in one-QB leagues.
items.text: Caleb Williams (CHI) will not practice this week with the Grade 2 hamstring strain from Sep 20, so Tyson Bagent (CHI) makes a second straight start @GB. Bagent was 25 of 34 for 268 and an interception in the NYJ win. Williams is QB11 rest of season for me and Bagent QB43; leave Bagent on the wire. Hold Williams.

Jayden Daniels (WAS) will practice in full this week with the left elbow, and Dan Quinn's goal is for him to start vs NYG, with Marcus Mariota out multiple weeks with the MCL. Washington wants a full week before it signs off. Daniels is QB18 rest of season for me; hold him. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.

Carnell Tate (TEN) caught 9 for 145 @BAL on 12 targets, about 39 percent of Tennessee's targets, a week after 9 targets and a route on 92 percent of the dropbacks vs NYG. WR34 rest of season for me, and the price only goes up from here. Trade for him; offer a WR3.

Dohnte Meyers (CIN) caught 7 for 82 vs JAX after Ja'Marr Chase left with a concussion in the second quarter, and Tee Higgins' adductor usually costs two to three weeks. With Andrei Iosivas on IR, Meyers is the outside receiver who plays until they are back. Claim him, 8 to 15 percent of FAAB.

David Montgomery (HOU) ran 10 times for 24 yards on 56 percent of the snaps vs DAL, and Woody Marks has scored in two straight weeks. RB19 rest of season for me, with the role shrinking. Trade him away; ask for a WR3 with a full-time route share.
items.price: a WR3 with a full-time route share

items.text: Tyler Huntley (BAL) is the backup behind Lamar Jackson, who has an MRI on the sprained left ankle Monday. A backup start would lift Baltimore's run share and cut the pass volume. In superflex, stash Huntley, 3 to 6 percent of FAAB; in one-QB leagues leave him on the wire.

Michael Mayer (LV) has 10 targets working in two-tight-end sets, and Brock Bowers, Mayer and Ian Thomas combined for 16 catches, 200 yards and 2 touchdowns vs KC. Bowers has 16 catches in two games back, so Mayer stays the second tight end. TE36 rest of season for me. Add him in TE-premium leagues only, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.

Nico Collins (HOU) caught 7 for 118 and two touchdowns on 69 percent of the snaps vs DAL in his first game back from the hamstring, and he is WR8 rest of season for me. Xavier Hutchinson (HOU) gives back the targets he picked up in Weeks 2 and 3 and is WR110 rest of season for me. Drop Hutchinson for any add on the list.

Marcus Mariota (WAS) sprained the right MCL again in the first quarter in London, the knee he hurt in August, and is expected to miss multiple weeks. Rookie Athan Kaliakmanis finished 15 of 33 for 186. QB34 rest of season for me. Drop Mariota in one-QB leagues.

DJ Moore (BUF) aggravated the shoulder he first hurt in Week 2 and left the NE loss in the second quarter, but it is not considered a long-term issue, per ESPN, and he is called day to day. He played through it and drew a team-high 10 targets in Week 3. WR24 rest of season for me; hold him. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.

items.watch: Mike Vrabel's update Monday and Wednesday's practice report
items.text: Mack Hollins (NE) left the BUF win in the third quarter with the calf, and Mike Vrabel said the Patriots were unsure he can practice for a couple of days. Hollins led New England with 16 targets through three games and caught 3 of 4 for 53 Sunday. He is WR98 rest of season for me, a dart throw even when healthy. Monitor; Vrabel's update Monday and Wednesday's practice report.

Tyreek Hill, a free agent since Miami released him in February, is expected to sign somewhere in the next few days, his agent told ESPN Monday, and Kansas City is one of the teams talking to him. He tore his ACL and dislocated his left knee in Week 4 last season and is aiming at a November return. He has no role yet and no rank from me. Monitor; where he signs this week.

Ladd McConkey (LAC) played @SEA through the foot, aggravated it in the first half and was ruled out for the rest of the game with no catches on 2 targets. He did not practice Thursday this week. WR23 rest of season for me; monitor Wednesday's practice report.

Jalen Coker (CAR) is inactive vs DET tonight with the quad, as the Saturday elevation of Ja'Seem Reed pointed to. Darren Waller, with a team-high 8 targets in Week 3 on a 51 percent snap share, is TE18 for me, a streamer tonight.

items.why: A rib setback that keeps him out of Wednesday's practice would change the call.
items.text: Mike Evans (SF) is active vs DEN after a week of side work with the ribs, and Ladd McConkey (LAC) is active @SEA with the foot. Evans is WR25 rest of season for me; hold him through the ribs. McConkey stays WR39 for me this week, a low-end flex play to a dart throw.
Zay Flowers (BAL) is active vs TEN after the questionable tag, and left tackle Ronnie Stanley (toe) is active too. Flowers caught 5 of 6 for 84 on 21 snaps in Week 3. WR9 for me this week.

Kenyon Sadiq (NYJ) is active @CHI after a week of limited practices with the back, and Mason Taylor, Adonai Mitchell and Breece Hall are inactive. Sadiq ran 58 percent of the routes at DET with Taylor out. TE14 for me, a borderline start this week.

Washington made Terry McLaurin (WAS) inactive in London vs IND with the hamstring he hurt in Friday's practice, along with Rachaad White. Stefon Diggs (WAS) is WR27 for me, a high-end WR3. Pivot to Diggs.

Ladd McConkey (LAC) is expected to play @SEA despite the questionable tag, per NFL Network's Ian Rapoport, after a limited Friday with the foot. He played 88 percent of the snaps in Week 3. WR39 for me, a low-end flex play to a dart throw. Monitor; LAC inactives at 2:55 PM ET.

Tyjae Spears (TEN) is active @BAL with the ankle, so the Titans keep the split. Tony Pollard (TEN) played 53 percent of the snaps with 80 percent of the early downs; RB29 for me, a high-end RB3 and a flex play.

Carolina put Xavier Legette (CAR) on injured reserve Saturday with the knee he hurt in Week 2, so he misses at least four games and is not back before Nov 8 vs DEN. He has not played since Week 2 and is WR106 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add on the list.

Carolina elevated receiver Ja'Seem Reed from the practice squad Saturday, the move Dave Canales said would come if Jalen Coker (CAR) could not play with the quad. Coker is outside my top 50 receivers either way; Darren Waller, with a team-high 8 targets in Week 3, is TE18 for me vs DET, a streamer Sunday night.

Kyle Shanahan calls Mike Evans (SF) a game-time decision with the ribs after side work only Friday, and Evans says he will try to play in a padded shirt. Monitor; SF inactives Sunday at 2:55 PM ET for the 4:25 PM ET kickoff vs DEN.
items.watch: SF inactives Sunday at 2:55 PM ET

items.text: The Colts ruled out Keenan Allen (IND) for London vs WAS with the groin after a Friday DNP and elevated Nick Westbrook-Ikhine from the practice squad. Pierce is on IR too, so Josh Downs and Tyler Warren are the targets. Pivot to Wan'Dale Robinson (WR38).
Josh Downs (IND) has seen 3, 9 and 11 targets since Alec Pierce went down, and Keenan Allen is ruled out for London. WR15 for me this week @WAS, a WR2.

Keaton Mitchell (LAC) played 38 percent of the snaps in Week 3 with 8 carries for 52, and he is at 5.0 a carry on the season, while Omarion Hampton's snap share has gone 58, 63 and 42 percent. RB46 rest of season for me. Stash Mitchell, 2 to 4 percent of FAAB.

Mike Washington Jr. (LV) has 15 carries for 102, and his head coach said on Sep 11 and again on Sep 28 that he earned more work. Ashton Jeanty still has 63 of the two backs' 78 carries and 16 targets and is RB9 for me vs KC. Washington is RB43 rest of season for me. Stash him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.

Houston's backfield is closer to even than Week 3 said: the snaps were about level in Week 1, 42 to 38 in Week 2 and 34 to 20 in Week 3, and Woody Marks has 8 targets to David Montgomery's (HOU) 7. Montgomery is at 2.8 a carry. RB22 for me this week vs DAL, an RB2; Marks is RB33, a low-end RB3.

Brian Thomas Jr. (JAX) was on the field for 23 of 62 snaps vs NE, 13 to 15 routes, and comes off it in two-tight-end sets. He is outside my top 50 receivers this week @CIN; sit him. WR40 rest of season for me.
Isaiah Likely (NYG) has gone 49, 69 and 84 percent of the snaps, with 22 routes on 27 dropbacks in Week 3. TE9 for me this week vs ARI.
Jake Ferguson (DAL) has 11 targets on 105 throws, and his snap share has gone 76, 60 and 69 percent while Brevyn Spann-Ford climbed to 38. TE20 for me @HOU, outside my top 12; sit him.

Jakobi Meyers (JAX) was limited Wednesday and Thursday with the thumb he has played through all season and has no designation for Sunday @CIN. He caught 7 for 64 and a touchdown vs NE on 81 percent of the snaps. WR31 for me, a low-end WR3, a low-end flex play.

Zay Flowers (BAL) is questionable vs TEN after the Ravens listed him limited Friday with rest beside the hamstring, a day after a full practice. He played 21 snaps in Week 3 and caught 5 of 6 for 84. WR9 for me this week; have a 1 PM receiver ready until the 11:30 AM ET inactives.

Seattle ruled Jadarian Price (SEA) out vs LAC Friday with the chest injury he reinjured Wednesday. Zach Charbonnet is Week 5 at the earliest, so Emanuel Wilson and George Holani split the backfield; Wilson ran for 92 yards on 21 carries in Week 2 when Price left. Wilson is RB31 for me, a low-end RB3. Pivot to Wilson.

Nico Collins (HOU) practiced in full Friday after limited sessions Wednesday and Thursday and has no designation for DAL, his first game back from the hamstring. WR13 for me, borderline WR1/WR2 this week.
DJ Moore (BUF) was limited all week with the shoulder but has no designation for NE. He led Buffalo with 10 targets on 64 percent of the snaps last week. WR23 for me this week, a WR2.
Dallas Goedert (PHI) is ruled out vs LAR with the sprained MCL, along with Hollywood Brown, so Mundt and Ertz split the tight end snaps. Juwan Johnson is TE8 for me this week. Pivot to Johnson.

Jaylen Wright (MIA) practiced in full Thursday, is expected to play at MIN and is listed first on the depth chart, with the staff signaling a shared workload. Ollie Gordon II played 82 percent of the snaps vs KC with Wright out. Gordon is RB35 for me, a low-end RB3; sit him.

Jaylen Wright (MIA) is back at full practice and listed as Miami's RB1 for Sunday at MIN, ahead of Ollie Gordon II, in a split the staff has already signaled. Stash him, 5 to 10 percent of FAAB, until the first-quarter carries show the lead role.
Ladd McConkey (LAC) did not practice Thursday after a limited Wednesday with the foot and is questionable @SEA. He is WR24 for me if active, a WR2. Monitor Sunday's inactives and have a backup ready.
Bucky Irving (TB) practiced in full Friday after two limited days with the glute and has no designation. RB19 for me this week vs GB, an RB2.
Puka Nacua (LAR) has no designation for Sunday @PHI, though Sean McVay said his snaps may be limited in his first game since Week 1. WR13 for me, borderline WR1/WR2 this week.
